source: The library's east entrance will be closed from Monday through Thursday because crews are replacing the automatic doors there. Visitors who need to enter the building should use the west entrance on Oak Street, which provides step-free access. The book return next to the east entrance will remain open during the work, and all scheduled programs will go ahead.
